en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Modern-sounding song, but I cannot name an author, so origin unclear. 'В' лицето грубам' is my reading ('I grow coarse in the face'); 'кој ли те пее' is also my reading.

lines.cyr: Без неа шетам, без неа спијам,
lines.lat: Bez nea šetam, bez nea spijam,
lines.en: Without her I walk, without her I sleep,
from her I carry deep sorrows.

lines.cyr: Кај да се смирам, кај да се скријам,
lines.lat: Kaj da se smiram, kaj da se skrijam,
lines.en: Where can I find calm, where can I hide,
waves beat in my chest for her.

lines.cyr: Проклета да си што не ме љубиш
lines.lat: Prokleta da si što ne me ljubiš
lines.en: Cursed be you who do not love me,
dissatisfied woman.
I am dying for you, unfaithful one,
I have burned up, north star.
Always I wear the same clothes,
I go far away, I come back empty,
I am ageing fast, I grow coarse in the face,
long sighs I send after her.

lines.cyr: Проклета да си што не ме љубиш

lines.en: Cursed be you who do not love me,

lines.cyr: Не јадам веќе, не пијам вина,
lines.lat: Ne jadam veḱe, ne pijam vina,
lines.en: I no longer eat, I no longer drink wine,

lines.cyr: кој ли те пее убава песно,
lines.lat: koj li te pee ubava pesno,
lines.en: whoever sings you, beautiful song,
I pine, I wander, the days pass,

lines.cyr: за тебе душо сегде е тесно.
lines.lat: za tebe dušo segde e tesno.
lines.en: for you, my soul, everywhere is narrow.
